name: Supply Chain & Logistics

territories.title: Plan supply chain & network
territories.short: Balance demand, supply, capacity, inventory and network policy.
territories.scope: Demand/supply/capacity planning, inventory and deployment policy, logistics network design, service policy and performance targets.

territories.title: Customer, commercial & order
territories.short: Shape the offer; quote, validate and manage the order commitment.
territories.scope: Customer enquiry, solution/rate design, quote and terms, order capture, validation, promise, amendment and cancellation. Quote and order remain separate underlying processes.

territories.title: Source & procure
territories.short: Govern sourcing, select providers, and establish and manage supply commitments.
territories.scope: Sourcing governance, category planning, supplier/provider selection, contracts, requisition and purchase order, direct/indirect procurement, supplier management and source returns.

territories.title: Transform, manufacture & value-add
territories.short: Convert material, asset or service inputs into the promised output.
territories.scope: Product manufacture, service transformation, maintenance/repair/overhaul and logistics value-added services, including scheduling, issue, execute, inspect/test, pack and release.

territories.title: Inventory & warehousing
territories.short: Receive, store, control, pick, pack, stage and transfer inventory.
territories.scope: Inbound receiving/unloading/inspection, putaway, storage, slotting, replenishment, picking, packing, staging, loading, cross-dock, counting/adjustment, VAS and yard/dock work.

territories.title: Transportation & distribution
territories.short: Plan, buy, tender/book, execute and monitor movement across nodes and legs.
territories.scope: Transport request, mode/service selection, rating, routing, consolidation, capacity procurement, tender/booking, appointment/equipment, pickup, origin handling, carriage, transshipment, visibility and freight-settlement handoffs. Transportation terminates at the handoff into destination/last-mile execution.

territories.title: Trade, customs & regulatory
territories.short: Classify, screen, declare, assess, inspect and release cross-border movement.
territories.scope: Classification, origin, valuation, licensing, restricted-party/sanctions controls, security filings, export/import declarations, duties/taxes, broker management, inspection/hold/release and post-entry activity.

territories.title: Delivery & last mile
territories.short: Plan destination execution, deliver or install, and capture acceptance evidence.
territories.scope: Destination readiness, appointment, last-mile dispatch, delivery or installation, delivery attempt, POD/acceptance and failed-delivery handoff. Customer interaction is mapped separately under Customer Service & Operations.

territories.title: Returns, reverse & recovery
territories.short: Authorize, collect, receive, diagnose, disposition and financially adjust returns.
territories.scope: Return initiation/authorization, reverse transport, receiving, diagnosis/test, repair/refurbish, disposition, storage, document update, replacement and financial/contract adjustment.

territories.title: Finance, billing & settlement
territories.short: Run distinct revenue, payable and freight-settlement cycles.
territories.scope: Customer billing/AR/collections and adjustments; supplier/carrier invoice audit/AP/payment; freight accrual, rating, allocation and settlement; trade-finance touchpoints where applicable.

territories.title: Execution control & exception recovery
territories.short: Observe, detect, recover, escalate and learn across every execution domain.
territories.scope: A cross-domain control rail for expected/actual state comparison, severity, ownership, response clock, containment, recovery, communication, escalation, closure and root-cause feedback.

territories.title: Resolution, claims & disputes
territories.short: Route cargo/service claims, billing disputes and insurance recovery through distinct controls.
territories.scope: A Page-0 umbrella with separate branches for cargo/service claims, billing/commercial disputes and insurance recovery/subrogation. Each branch uses different standing, evidence, liability, approval and settlement rules.
sub: Cargo/service claim: notice → evidence → liability → loss → adjudication
Billing/commercial dispute: charge → contract/rate → invoice → evidence → adjustment
Insurance recovery/subrogation: insured event → policy → coverage → recovery

territories.title: Customer service & operations
territories.short: Manage enquiries, notifications, service requests, complaints and case resolution.
territories.scope: Customer contact and service operations linked to—rather than substituted for—authoritative order, shipment, delivery, billing and claim states.

territories.title: Assets, equipment & maintenance
territories.short: Plan, allocate, inspect, maintain and reposition operating assets and equipment.
territories.scope: Fleet, vehicle, trailer, container, ULD, wagon/railcar, material-handling equipment and facility-asset availability, allocation, inspection, maintenance, utilization and repositioning—conditional by operating model.

territories.title: Master & reference data
territories.short: Govern party, location, item, asset, code and relationship identities across systems.
territories.scope: Cross-enterprise identity, reference-data, code-set, hierarchy, relationship, quality, stewardship, version and distribution controls. No universal shipment identifier is assumed.

transformationHeuristics.label: Human / inspection dependency
transformationHeuristics.hypothesis: Potential cycle-time or consistency exposure where execution depends on human inspection, adjudication or manual work.

transformationHeuristics.label: Reconciliation dependency
transformationHeuristics.hypothesis: Potential rework or state-consistency exposure where execution depends on reconciliation, discrepancy resolution or duplicate control.

transformationHeuristics.label: Cross-system authority handoff
transformationHeuristics.hypothesis: Potential synchronization exposure where the producing system and system of authority are different governed systems.

transformationHeuristics.label: Conditional / exception branch
transformationHeuristics.hypothesis: Potential operational complexity where the task is conditional or exception-path execution rather than the standard path.

transformationHeuristics.label: Evidence / document dependency
transformationHeuristics.hypothesis: Potential handling or validation effort where the task depends on multiple governed documents or scan/photo/document evidence.

transformationHeuristics.label: Time-window dependency
transformationHeuristics.hypothesis: Potential service-level exposure where execution depends on a governed validity period, cutoff, response clock or operating window.

transformationHeuristics.label: Control / approval dependency
transformationHeuristics.hypothesis: Potential control latency or audit burden where execution depends on explicit approval, override, qualification, regulatory or release controls.

transformationHeuristics.label: Financial-object dependency
transformationHeuristics.hypothesis: Potential financial leakage or settlement exposure if the governed execution state feeding a financial object is incomplete or inconsistent.
